NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION
Dear Jordan Example:
We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by Dr. Casey Placeholder for an MRI of
the lumbar spine (CPT 72148), requested on September 8, 2026.
Reason for our decision
Your request has been denied because the service is not medically necessary under our
clinical policy for advanced imaging of the lower back. Our records do not show six weeks of
conservative treatment, such as physical therapy, before imaging was requested.
This decision was made by a board-certified physician reviewer. You or your doctor may ask
for a copy of the clinical policy and any documents we used, free of charge.
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL LETTER - created for PatientShield demo mode - Page 1 of 2

Your right to appeal
If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to file an internal appeal. You must
submit your appeal within 180 calendar days of the date you receive this notice. Send your
written appeal to Pinebrook Health Plan, Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 4410, Newark, NJ 07101, or
fax it to (800) 555-0199.
If your condition is urgent, you or your doctor may request an expedited appeal by calling
(800) 555-0142. We will decide expedited appeals within 72 hours.
External review
If we uphold our decision after your internal appeal, you may request an independent
external review through the New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance Independent
Health Care Appeals Program (IHCAP). You must request external review within 4 months of
receiving our final internal appeal decision.
Questions? Call Member Services at (800) 555-0142, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
